technology_predicate: go.mod requires github.com/alecthomas/kong v1.8.1; the built binary's module metadata (go version -m) lists github.com/alecthomas/kong; none of the in-scope migrated production files import github.com/spf13/cobra. The predicate is checked against those three facts alone: the reference implementation's file names, struct names and call sites are implementation details and are deliberately never asserted (a migration may mount the Kong root in a file of its own choosing).
